input.subject: Nico Robin
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Hana Hana limb replication, multi-target Clutch/holds, Gigante Fleur and Demonio Fleur through Wano. Powers blossom on targets; do not make hands traveling bullets. Holds limited by enemy eligibility and boss immunity. Demonio is a technique or form of limb construction, not a new Devil Fruit, and black coloration must not falsely claim Armament. Archaeology and body scouting cannot become invented economy/range magic. Use the supplied fresh, targeted fruit research to implement the actual distinctions among Clutch, Gigante Fleur and Demonio Fleur. Research was acquired by the orchestration CLI in this campaign; do not claim source acquisition was unavailable just because your model call receives captured pages. Do not conflate numerical tuning gaps with missing character evidence.

context.cutoff: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
context.coverage: Character-specific capabilities are requirements to verify, not evidence. Record unsupported facts as gaps. No old generated artifacts supplied.

knowledge.subject: Nico Robin
gaps: The supplied official Wano story summary does not provide detailed Robin-specific battle evidence; the detailed ability claims rely primarily on the supplied wiki page and its cited manga references.
The supplied pages do not establish a separate Devil Fruit awakening for Robin by the end of Wano, so awakening is unresolved and not asserted.
The supplied pages do not establish Haki use by Robin by the end of Wano; any claim that she possesses or uses Haki is unsupported here.

The ability page includes anime-only, film-only, video-game, SBS, and post-Wano material. Those items were excluded from the selected manga-through-Wano record unless they were also supported as manga facts through the requested endpoint.
The supplied ability page contains some later references beyond Wano, including Egghead-era material; those later facts are outside the requested continuity and were not used.

No supplied page gives a complete exhaustive inventory of every technique Robin has used through Wano; the named techniques listed are those documented in the supplied material and relevant to the selected continuity.
